events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 years since his passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Three decades since his tragic death, Tupac Shakur's music and message still resonate. What's your favourite track from the legend?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Remembering a guitar legend
events.blurb: Guitar icon Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi's Genius Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day in 1970. His influence on guitar music is simply immeasurable.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road's Enduring Appeal
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That iconic cover and even more iconic tracks. What's your favourite from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and still inspiring.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: The original iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod's Impact
angles.copy: 25 years ago today, Apple put '1,000 songs in your pocket' with the original iPod. How did it change your music listening habits?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, what's your ultimate 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86 today
events.blurb: Legendary musician and peace activist John Lennon was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedic legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album's Impact
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What are your standout tracks?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, Queen's legendary frontman Freddie Mercury passed away. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Timeless Talent
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly one of a kind.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' is 61 today
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: 61 years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' album that truly pushed boundaries and influenced countless artists.

events.title: John Lennon: 46 years since his passing
events.blurb: Music icon John Lennon was tragically shot and killed on this day in 1980. He would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to echo globally.
